import textwrap
import types
from test import support

def _t():
    resurrected = []
    exec(textwrap.dedent('\n            def gen():\n                try:\n                    yield\n                except:\n                    resurrected.append(g)\n\n            g = gen()\n            next(g)\n        '), {'resurrected': resurrected})
    support.gc_collect()
    assert len(resurrected) == 1, ('assertEqual', len(resurrected), 1)
    assert isinstance(resurrected[0].gi_code, types.CodeType), ('assertIsInstance', resurrected[0].gi_code, types.CodeType)
try:
    _t()
except BaseException as _e:
    print('ORACLE_EXC ' + type(_e).__name__ + ' ' + repr(str(_e)))
else:
    print('ok')

import inspect

def _t():

    def a():
        assert inspect.getgeneratorstate(gen_b) == inspect.GEN_RUNNING, ('assertEqual', inspect.getgeneratorstate(gen_b), inspect.GEN_RUNNING)
        assert gen_b.gi_yieldfrom is None, ('assertIsNone', gen_b.gi_yieldfrom)
        yield
        assert inspect.getgeneratorstate(gen_b) == inspect.GEN_RUNNING, ('assertEqual', inspect.getgeneratorstate(gen_b), inspect.GEN_RUNNING)
        assert gen_b.gi_yieldfrom is None, ('assertIsNone', gen_b.gi_yieldfrom)

    def b():
        assert gen_b.gi_yieldfrom is None, ('assertIsNone', gen_b.gi_yieldfrom)
        yield from a()
        assert gen_b.gi_yieldfrom is None, ('assertIsNone', gen_b.gi_yieldfrom)
        yield
        assert gen_b.gi_yieldfrom is None, ('assertIsNone', gen_b.gi_yieldfrom)
    gen_b = b()
    assert inspect.getgeneratorstate(gen_b) == inspect.GEN_CREATED, ('assertEqual', inspect.getgeneratorstate(gen_b), inspect.GEN_CREATED)
    assert gen_b.gi_yieldfrom is None, ('assertIsNone', gen_b.gi_yieldfrom)
    gen_b.send(None)
    assert inspect.getgeneratorstate(gen_b) == inspect.GEN_SUSPENDED, ('assertEqual', inspect.getgeneratorstate(gen_b), inspect.GEN_SUSPENDED)
    assert gen_b.gi_yieldfrom.gi_code.co_name == 'a', ('assertEqual', gen_b.gi_yieldfrom.gi_code.co_name, 'a')
    gen_b.send(None)
    assert inspect.getgeneratorstate(gen_b) == inspect.GEN_SUSPENDED, ('assertEqual', inspect.getgeneratorstate(gen_b), inspect.GEN_SUSPENDED)
    assert gen_b.gi_yieldfrom is None, ('assertIsNone', gen_b.gi_yieldfrom)
    [] = gen_b
    assert inspect.getgeneratorstate(gen_b) == inspect.GEN_CLOSED, ('assertEqual', inspect.getgeneratorstate(gen_b), inspect.GEN_CLOSED)
    assert gen_b.gi_yieldfrom is None, ('assertIsNone', gen_b.gi_yieldfrom)
try:
    _t()
except BaseException as _e:
    print('ORACLE_EXC ' + type(_e).__name__ + ' ' + repr(str(_e)))
else:
    print('ok')
